tagline: Attach design docs and specs from Google Drive to Linear issues automatically
metaTitle: Linear + Google Drive Integration: Specs on Issues
metaDescription: Attach Drive spec docs and meeting notes to Linear issues, and create issues from new specs. GAIA keeps context close. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering issues rarely exist in isolation. Behind most Linear issues is a Google Drive folder full of context: the product spec, the design doc, the API contract, the meeting notes from the scoping session. But that context lives in the folder while the issue lives in the tracker, and the link between them is usually an afterthought — a URL pasted into a comment that gets buried, or nothing at all.

GAIA builds and maintains the connection between documents and issues automatically. When a new feature issue is created in Linear, GAIA searches the configured Drive folder for matching spec documents and attaches them. When a new spec doc is created and follows your team's naming convention, GAIA creates the corresponding issue and links back to the doc.

This integration eliminates the document hunt that slows down engineers at the start of every task and ensures that the historical context behind an issue is always one click away.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive spec docs to issues
useCases.description: When a new issue is created with the feature label, GAIA searches the product specs folder in Drive for a document matching the issue title and attaches the link automatically so engineers have immediate access to the specification.

useCases.title: Create issues from new spec docs
useCases.description: When a new spec document is added to the designated folder and marked Ready for Engineering, GAIA creates a corresponding Linear issue with the document title, a description pulled from the doc summary, and a link back to the source document.

useCases.title: Attach meeting notes to related issues
useCases.description: When a Google Doc meeting note is created after an engineering planning session and contains issue IDs in the title or body, GAIA attaches the note to each referenced issue so decision context is preserved.

useCases.title: Generate post-mortem docs in Drive from Linear incidents
useCases.description: When an issue labeled incident is resolved, GAIA creates a post-mortem document in the designated folder pre-populated with the issue title, timeline, and description so the team can fill in the analysis without starting from scratch.

useCases.title: Organize docs by Linear project
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a folder structure mirroring your projects. When an issue is created in a project, GAIA creates a corresponding subfolder so all related documents are organized consistently without manual folder management.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Drive and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Google Workspace account and Linear workspace. Designate the folders GAIA should watch and search, and map them to teams or projects.
Define the naming conventions GAIA should use to match documents to issues, which events in Drive should create issues, and which issue events should create documents.
GAIA monitors both sides and maintains the links between issues and documents in real time. Engineers find their specs on the issue; documents in the folder always reference their related issues.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require a specific naming convention for Drive documents?
faqs.answer: GAIA works best with consistent naming conventions but can also be configured with flexible matching patterns using regular expressions. You can also link documents to issues manually and GAIA will register and maintain those explicit links.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach shared files or only files owned by me?
faqs.answer: GAIA can attach any file the authorized Google account has access to, including shared drives and files shared with your domain. It respects existing sharing permissions and does not change access settings.

faqs.question: What file types does GAIA support when attaching files to Linear?
faqs.answer: GAIA can attach links to any file type including Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and uploaded PDFs, images, or other files. Issues show the attached URLs with metadata previews for Google Workspace file types.
